evidence.note: CGRS is a training-free, decoding-time method that suppresses reflection-trigger tokens (e.g. "Wait", "But") probabilistically, in proportion to a token-entropy-based certainty score computed at checkpoint probes, cutting reasoning length by 18.5-41.9% with little to no accuracy loss.
evidence.title: Efficient Reasoning for Large Reasoning Language Models via Certainty-Guided Reflection Suppression
